explanation: This login endpoint is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because an f-string interpolates json_data['email'] directly inside single quotes in the SELECT query. An attacker submitting a crafted JSON payload could alter the query to bypass admin verification and obtain valid JWT cookies. The repair replaces the interpolated value with %s and passes (json_data['email'], ) separately, though complete safety cannot be verified without seeing database_utilities.execute_query.
